reference.source: Runway center fitted to terrain 2026-10-16 with tools/sites/survey.ts (11.0721 N 125.0090 E, about 17 km south of Tacloban): of the grid points within 3.5 km of Tanauan town, heading 0 over this strip has the least relief for 2 km (4 m, all land above 2.7 m); heading 0 also matches Tacloban and Dulag. Length 1500 and width 45 m are the same ESTIMATES as the other bases; the Army history gives no Tanauan dimensions. No Tanauan runway exists in any window before work began after 28 Nov.

pre-invasion.note: No field: the site is farmland.

assault.note: No field: the site is farmland.

buildup.note: Site selected after the Buri/San Pablo abandonment; first clearing and a site office after 28 Nov.

added.cite: Construction camps used Quonsets (Navy ch. XXIX); a site office there is inferred, not documented for Tanauan.
